title: Private Music Studio Themed Suite, Sparkling Clean
description:
Experience Music City with your own private music studio space! Situated in our walk-out basement with windows, located  between Nashville and Franklin, about 20 minutes drive the to downtown, quiet neighborhood, free parking on the street, walking distance from local boutiques, cafes, and restaurants at Lenox Village, Edley’s BBQ, Prince's Hot Chicken, Chick fil a, Starbucks, Kroger, and Walmart within 1 mile. Close to hiking, biking and running trails.

The space
Formerly a music studio, this separate living space on the basement level has it's own living room/dining room, kitchenette with coffee bar, full bathroom, 1 bedroom with 2 large windows, cable TV, wifi, work desk/vanity, and an acoustic guitar for inspiration!

Guest access
Only the indoor space is available at this time. Smokers may use the drive way to smoke.

Other things to note
We are a family of 3 with myself and 2 children.

Please Note-
The kitchenette sink does not have a garbage disposal and the plumbing is not designed to handle food disposal. Please scrape your food, especially grease, into the garbage can provided and rinse dishes normally. 
 
Nashville Short Term Rental Permit #2018031461.
